rows.commentary: 7.1: Randell drops it short to Devdutt Padikkal, who watches it sail through to the keeper as a variation in length.
7.2: Randell targets the channel outside off, and Devdutt Padikkal lets the length ball pass safely to the keeper.
7.3: Randell drifts one down leg, prompting an unsuccessful clip from Devdutt Padikkal as it angles past him.
7.4: Randell pitches outside off on a length, and Devdutt Padikkal offers no stroke, leaving it entirely alone.
7.5: Randell angles one inward, and Devdutt Padikkal cushions it down into the off-side with gentle hands.
7.6: Randell comes from round the wicket with a fuller delivery, which Devdutt Padikkal blocks solidly toward mid-on.
8.1: Fraser Sheat tests Sai Sudharsan, who strides forward to push a defensive stroke into the off-side.
8.2: Fraser Sheat finds movement away, and Sai Sudharsan tucks his bat away to let the delivery pass to the keeper.
8.3: Fraser Sheat serves up a full delivery, and Sai Sudharsan gets behind the line to punch it crisply past mid-off for four.
8.4: Fraser Sheat delivers a length ball that Sai Sudharsan walks at, turning it off the cue-end toward mid-wicket.
8.5: Fraser Sheat goes wide of the crease to angle one away, and Sai Sudharsan gracefully sways out of the line.
8.6: Fraser Sheat attacks the stumps on a length, and Sai Sudharsan meets it with a soft-handed defensive prod into the off-side.
9.1: Randell attacks the channel with a length ball angling into off, leaving Devdutt Padikkal unbothered as it sails through to the gloveman.
9.2: Randell tests the corridor again with another delivery outside off, and Devdutt Padikkal watches it sail safely past into the keeper's mitts.
9.3: Randell finds sharp movement off the seam to flash past Devdutt Padikkal's outside edge as the batter keeps his hands tucked close.
9.4: Randell squares up the batter once more with a delivery holding its line, zipping past the flailing blade of Devdutt Padikkal.
9.5: Randell extracts brilliant late nibble away from an open stance, completely beating Devdutt Padikkal's attempted defensive prod.
9.6: Randell angles the length in, squaring up Devdutt Padikkal who guides the educated edge safely on the bounce toward the slips.
19.5: Jarrod McKay drops it on a length outside off, and Devdutt Padikkal simply guides it past wide mid-off for a single.

19.6: Jarrod McKay pushes it wide outside off on a length, watched safely through to the keeper by Sai Sudharsan as the bowler labors through an expensive spell at five runs an over across five overs.
20.1: Randell goes back of a length outside off, prompting Devdutt Padikkal to hang back and cushion it softly into the off-side.
20.2: Randell delivers right behind the line, allowing Devdutt Padikkal to drop his bat and block it cleanly into the off-side.
20.3: Randell strays down the leg side, and Devdutt Padikkal offers no stroke, leaving it comfortably for the keeper.
20.4: Randell targets the stumps with a fuller delivery angled in, which Devdutt Padikkal solidly returns straight back to the bowler.
20.5: Randell angles one in with a full face, and Devdutt Padikkal locks bat and pad together to dead-bat it down towards mid-on.
20.6: Randell hits a good length on off, patted away with gentle hands into the off-side by Devdutt Padikkal to scamper through for a single.
21.1: Fraser Sheat angles a length ball into Devdutt Padikkal, who misses his intended tuck and takes a heavy blow between front pad and thigh guard that leaves him hobbled in grimacing pain.
21.2: Fraser Sheat feeds a fuller length delivery, which Devdutt Padikkal quietly nudges down in the direction of mid-wicket.
21.3: Fraser Sheat hits a length outside off that nips away sharply, leaving Devdutt Padikkal pushing vainly at thin air as it beats the outside edge.
21.4: Fraser Sheat pitches on a length, and Devdutt Padikkal hangs back to punch it crisply wide of cover point for three runs.
21.5: Fraser Sheat drops it full and angles it into the pads, allowing Sai Sudharsan to push it straight back.
21.6: Sheat finds sudden, vicious lift from a length that catches Sai Sudharsan completely by surprise, forcing an awkward defensive push into the off-side.
22.1: Randell attacks the channel outside off, and Devdutt Padikkal taps it away to pick up a single.
22.2: Randell targets the middle and leg corridor, and Sai Sudharsan works it away toward backward square leg for one.
24.1: Randell angles the ball in, and Sai Sudharsan tucks it straight to the fielder stationed at square leg.
24.2: Randell fires in a short-of-length delivery, which Sai Sudharsan drops solidly down into the off-side.
24.3: Randell strays slightly, allowing Sai Sudharsan to nudge it behind square on the on-side for a single.
24.4: Randell digs it in short, and Devdutt Padikkal expertly rolls his wrists over the pull to race it away to the deep square fence for four.
24.5: Randell serves a length ball that Devdutt Padikkal calmly stabs down into the off-side.
24.6: Randell drifts it in on a length, leaving Devdutt Padikkal to simply block it straight back to the bowler.
25.1: Fraser Sheat drops it on a length near the hips, where Sai Sudharsan tucks it down toward the fielder at leg gully.
25.2: Fraser Sheat tests him with a short ball, and Sai Sudharsan pivots to pull it down to long leg for a single.
25.3: Fraser Sheat overpitches outside off, allowing Devdutt Padikkal to drop to one knee and hammer a boundary through mid-off to reach forty-nine.
25.4: Fraser Sheat attacks the channel on a fuller length, but Devdutt Padikkal can only push the ball straight to the fielder stationed at cover.
25.5: Fraser Sheat drops the ball on a length and angles it across, inviting Devdutt Padikkal to comfortably offer no stroke and let it through to the keeper.
25.6: Fraser Sheat drifts one down leg past a tucking Devdutt Padikkal, bringing a close to the morning session with the batter stranded on forty-nine at lunch on day one.
26.1: Kristian Clarke comes round the wicket with a full delivery on the stumps, which Sai Sudharsan promptly meets with a dead-bat front-foot defense.
26.2: Kristian Clarke strays onto the pads, and Sai Sudharsan neatly glances it away to deep backward square leg for a couple of runs.
26.3: No-ball from Kristian Clarke to Sai Sudharsan.
26.3: Dot ball from Kristian Clarke to Sai Sudharsan.
36.6: Fraser Sheat hurls down a vicious nip-backer that arches past Devdutt Padikkal's off stump by a whisker as the batsman wisely shoulders arms.
37.1: Randell delivers a fullish ball outside off which Yash Rathod calmly taps towards mid-off.
37.2: Randell hits a good length that straightens, allowing Yash Rathod to get well behind the line and defend toward the cover region.
37.3: Randell tests Yash Rathod with a tight line, the batsman playing it right under his eyes to dead-bat it toward mid-wicket.
37.4: Randell breaks through as Yash Rathod edges a tentative prod through to wicketkeeper Mitchell Hay, ending a 13-run knock.
37.5: Randell angles the ball sharply into Dhruv Jurel's pads, who nervously lofts an uppish flick safely into the gap between mid-wicket and mid-on for two runs.
37.6: Randell targets a shortish length outside off, and Dhruv Jurel shuffles across his stumps to watch it sail through to the keeper.
38.1: Fraser Sheat offers a full and wide delivery that Devdutt Padikkal drills past mid-off, racing into the 80s despite less-than-ideal timing.
38.2: Fraser Sheat strikes as Devdutt Padikkal chops a short ball back onto his own stumps, departing in bitter disappointment for 80.
38.3: Fraser Sheat traps Smaran Ravichandran plumb in front for a golden duck with a sharp inswinger that the batsman shockingly leaves alone on the crease.
38.4: Fraser Sheat is denied his hat-trick as Washington Sundar misses a leg-side clip, the ball sliding harmlessly down leg.
38.5: Fraser Sheat fires in a fullish, wide delivery with heavy inswing, leaving Washington Sundar unbothered as he lets it pass.
38.6: Fraser Sheat spears one in off a length, sharply nipping back, and Washington Sundar gets his body directly behind the line to block it solidly.
49.3: Kristian Clarke delivers wide of off stump, and Washington Sundar watches the short ball sail past safely.
49.4: Kristian Clarke probes away from the bat, inviting Washington Sundar to offer a shoulder to the shortish delivery.
49.5: Kristian Clarke pitches full outside off, and Washington Sundar comfortably allows it through to the keeper.
49.6: Kristian Clarke challenges the batter, but Washington Sundar gets over the ball to dead-bat it into the off side.
50.1: Jarrod McKay traps Dhruv Jurel on the pads with a sharp angle, but the umpire dismisses the massive appeal.
50.2: Jarrod McKay drifts down leg, leaving Dhruv Jurel to miss his attempted clip.
50.3: Jarrod McKay offers a fuller length around off, which Dhruv Jurel wisely ignores.
50.4: Jarrod McKay serves a fuller length, and Dhruv Jurel cashes in with a pristine on-drive past mid-on for four.
50.5: Jarrod McKay induces an outside edge with soft hands, trickling harmlessly toward the slips.
50.6: Jarrod McKay angles one in from just short of a good length, met solidly by Dhruv Jurel's defensive prod.
51.1: Kristian Clarke swings it into the pads, allowing Washington Sundar to clip a single toward deep square leg.
51.2: Kristian Clarke attacks from back of a length, forcing Dhruv Jurel to jab it down toward gully.
51.3: Kristian Clarke targets the stumps, but Dhruv Jurel steps forward to block it down safely toward mid-on.
51.4: Kristian Clarke tests the channel outside off, and Dhruv Jurel wisely watches it pass into the gloves.
51.5: Kristian Clarke bangs it in short, Dhruv Jurel nudges it square, and Washington shouts an instant refusal.
51.6: Kristian Clarke gets the ball to straighten off a length, drawing a desperate edge from Dhruv Jurel that dies well short of second slip.
52.1: Jarrod McKay fires it into the stumps, and Washington Sundar cushions it softly away on the leg side.
52.2: Jarrod McKay digs it in short, letting the bouncer sail harmlessly over Washington Sundar as he ducks out of the line.
52.3: Jarrod McKay pulls back his length slightly, and Washington Sundar gets solidly behind the line to block.
52.4: Jarrod McKay delivers on a length, and Washington Sundar steps forward to let it go.
52.5: Jarrod McKay attacks the pads, allowing Washington Sundar to flick it away neatly to backward square leg for a single.
60.5: Jayden Lennox floats it up, Manav Suthar drives uppishly, and the bowler reacts sharply to his left to intercept.
60.6: Jayden Lennox angles a short and wide delivery outside off, and Manav Suthar swings through the line and misses.
61.1: Jarrod McKay digs it in short, allowing Dhruv Jurel to camp back and hammer a ferocious pull through mid-wicket for four.
61.2: Jarrod McKay targets full outside off, and DJ attempts a drive only to be surprised as the ball nips sharply back in to beat the bat.
61.3: Jarrod McKay drops one outside off stump, opening DJ up slightly before he manages to keep it safely out.
61.4: Jarrod McKay delivers on a short of length, and DJ taps the ball into the off-side.
61.5: Jarrod McKay serves a fullish length, prompting DJ to drive it straight back to the bowler.
61.6: Jarrod McKay pitches it full, and DJ confidently gets forward to defend.
62.1: Jayden Lennox fires a flatter delivery around off stump, and Manav Suthar stays back to defend.
62.2: Jayden Lennox slides a short and wide delivery past off stump, which Manav Suthar wisely ignores.
62.3: Jayden Lennox tosses it up, and Manav Suthar advances to the pitch of the ball and belts it down the ground for four.
62.4: Jayden Lennox flights the ball in, and Manav Suthar leans forward to press it firmly into the wicket.
62.5: Jayden Lennox delivers a flatter ball to Manav Suthar, who blocks it with no run, while the ball arcs toward the leg side.
62.6: Jayden Lennox bowls a flatter delivery outside off stump to Manav Suthar, who ignores it and no run is taken.
63.1: Jarrod McKay sends a short‑of‑length ball on the stumps to Dhruv Jurel, who clips it away through square leg for two runs.
63.2: Jarrod McKay bowls a short‑of‑length delivery outside off stump to Dhruv Jurel, who lets it go for no run.
63.3: Jarrod McKay delivers a short‑of‑length ball on the stumps to Dhruv Jurel, who clips it through square leg for a single.
63.4: Jarrod McKay bowls a fullish, swinging ball to Manav Suthar, who attempts to clip it behind square but it hits the pad and rolls to the leg side for leg byes.
63.5: No run for Dhruv Jurel off Jarrod McKay.
74.1: Jarrod McKay streams in round the wicket, digging it short down leg, and Dhruv Jurel wisely offers no shot.
74.2: Another venomous bumper from McKay forces Jurel to duck beneath the line as the umpire signals the first of the over.
74.3: Jarrod McKay digs this one short into the ribs, forcing Dhruv Jurel into a swivel-pull that finds the fielder stationed deep at long-leg for a dot ball.
74.4: The short ball gets big on Jurel, crashing straight into his helmet grille and prompting an immediate concussion check as the physio rushes out.
74.5: Jurel gets inside the line of a shortish leg-side delivery, pulling it fine past the diving keeper to race away for a boundary.
74.6: Firing back after taking a blow, Jurel swivels inside the line and absolutely launches the short ball over fine leg for a maximum.
75.1: Jayden Lennox hurries Akash Deep with a flat delivery, catching him on the pad as he attempts a flick.
75.2: Lennox pushes it full on the stumps, inviting Akash to stride forward and dead-bat the ball.
75.3: Keeping the trajectory flat, Lennox asks another question that Akash meets comfortably off the front foot.
75.4: Akash reaches out on the front foot to a wider delivery, caressing his drive straight to short cover.
75.5: Lennox attacks a fullish length outside off, prompting a defensive prod just to the left of mid-off.
75.6: Akash digs out a very full, quicker delivery on the stumps, pushing it firmly toward the cover-point region.
76.1: McKay fires it in short and into the body, allowing Jurel to rock back and pull it with authority through backward square leg for four.
76.2: McKay digs another short one in, forcing Jurel to duck neatly beneath the soaring delivery.
76.3: McKay tries the short length again, but Jurel's pull shot towards mid-wicket yields no run.
76.4: McKay targets the ribs with another short delivery, pushed along the turf to deep square leg for no score.
76.5: McKay angles one back in sharply off a short length to strike the inner thigh, drawing a loud and unsuccessful LBW appeal.
76.6: McKay delivers back of a length on off stump, comfortably fended away by Jurel from his crease.
77.1: Lennox drops it short, giving Akash Deep all the time in the world to stand tall and dispatch it nonchalantly over long-on for six.
77.2: Akash Deep does not score off Jayden Lennox.
77.3: Jayden Lennox lands it extremely full, and Akash Deep instantly drives the ball toward the covers.
85.2: Jarrod McKay targets a fullish length outside off, drawing Akash Deep into a watchful leave as the ball shapes away.
85.3: Jarrod McKay drops it on a short of length at the stumps, where Akash Deep meets it with a quiet push to the on-side.
85.4: Jarrod McKay tests the batsman with a slight short ball outside the off stump, prompting Akash Deep to sway out of harm's way.
85.5: Jarrod McKay delivers on the stumps, and Akash Deep swings aggressively, dragging it off the inner half past mid-wicket for a boundary.
85.6: Jarrod McKay attacks the stumps again, but Akash Deep gets right behind the line to block it securely.
86.1: Randell bangs it in short, allowing Dhruv Jurel to pull it down to fine leg for a single that edges him onto 99.
86.2: Randell angles a short of length delivery away from Akash Deep, who plays inside the line and beats the outside edge.
86.3: Randell targets leg stump with a sharp delivery, clipped neatly past square leg by Akash Deep to hustle through for two runs.
86.4: Randell tests the front foot defense, and Akash Deep steps forward to comfortably block the ball.
86.5: Randell fires it in on a short of length at the stumps, softly nudged by Akash Deep toward fine leg as they decline the single.
86.6: Randell serves up a back of length ball that Akash Deep mistimes on a mighty slog over mid-off, scrambling three more runs to keep the strike.
87.1: Jayden Lennox hurries Akash Deep with a sharp slider, forcing the batsman onto the back foot to tuck it toward mid-wicket off the inner half.
87.2: Jayden Lennox lands it full on off stump, inviting Akash Deep forward to steer it straight back to the bowler.
87.3: Jayden Lennox offers a long-hop on off, tapped firmly into the on side toward mid-on as Jurel remains stranded on 99.
87.4: Jayden Lennox extracts sharp turn away, beating Akash Deep inside the line to catch the outside edge safely on the bounce through to first slip.
87.5: Jayden Lennox beats the back-foot punch onto the pad, drawing a confident LBW appeal that the umpire rightfully dismisses down the leg-side.
87.6: Jayden Lennox fires a quicker delivery onto the stumps to conclude Day 1, comfortably pushed back to the bowler.
94.2: Randell drifts an inswinger in to Mohammed Siraj, who pushes forward with leaden feet and inside-edges the ball down toward square leg.
94.3: Randell maintains a disciplined line outside the off stump as Mohammed Siraj watches it sail past and offers no stroke.
94.4: Randell catches Mohammed Siraj on the pads with an inswinger, sparking a frantic scramble for a leg-bye that they safely complete.
94.5: Randell bangs it back of a length, allowing Akash Deep to neatly tuck the delivery away through the square leg region for a single.
94.6: Randell serves up a full delivery that holds its line outside off, tempting Mohammed Siraj into a drive that beats the groping bat.
95.1: Fraser Sheat induces a thick outside edge from Akash Deep, squeezing the ball through the vacant gap between second slip and gully for four.
95.2: Fraser Sheat targets the channel outside off with an out-seamer, and Akash Deep is entirely content to leave it alone.
95.3: Fraser Sheat drops it on a short of length into the middle-stump corridor, where Akash Deep solidly dead-bats it back down.
95.4: Fraser Sheat digs it in short just outside leg, leaving Akash Deep to swing fruitlessly at thin air as he attempts the hook.
95.5: Fraser Sheat produces a gem that nips away sharply off the seam, whistling over the top of Akash Deep's off-stump after beating his push.
95.6: Fraser Sheat strays full onto the pads, and Akash Deep easily tickles it away toward fine leg to pick up a single.
96.1: Randell fires in a lively short of a good length delivery that Akash Deep judges expertly, withdrawing his bat and watching it pass.
96.2: Randell pushes one slightly fuller, and Akash Deep muscles a ferocious cross-line heave that bounces over the rope through the vast expanse between long-on and deep midwicket.
96.3: Randell digs it in short, allowing Akash Deep to swivel beneath the line and pull it disdainfully around to the fine leg boundary.
96.4: Randell offers a short-of-length delivery, which Akash Deep meets on the back foot, exquisitely opening the face to late-cut past the diving gully fielder for three boundaries in succession.

96.5: Randell delivers a full, inswinging ball that Akash Deep clips through square leg with supreme confidence, securing four consecutive boundaries and bringing up a jubilant fifty amid applause from the pavilion.
96.6: Randell goes short once more, and Akash Deep controls a soft wristy pull out to deep backward square leg to retain the strike.
97.1: Fraser Sheat angles across a full outswinger which Akash Deep drives toward mid-off before declining the single.
97.2: Fraser Sheat attacks with width, and Akash Deep flashes lightning-fast hands to carve the ball away to deep point for a single.
1.6: Mukesh Kumar drops short of length on off and shapes away as Curtis Heaphy smartly covers his stump to let it pass.
2.1: Mohammed Siraj angles a delivery from leg-stump that nips away sharply to catch Rhys Mariu high on the pads, drawing a loud but unsuccessful appeal.
2.2: Mohammed Siraj tests the New Zealand A skipper with a back of a length ball on off that swings away, drawing a loose push from Rhys Mariu.
2.3: Mohammed Siraj hits a hard length on off which moves away, prompting Rhys Mariu to play inside the line and leave it alone.
2.4: Mohammed Siraj fires one on a length in the fifth stump channel, inducing Rhys Mariu to offer no shot to the swinging delivery.
2.5: Mohammed Siraj targets just outside off where the ball nips away, leaving Rhys Mariu to prod tentatively and miss.
2.6: Mohammed Siraj completes a consecutive maiden as Rhys Mariu shoulders arms to a swinging length delivery on the sixth stump.
3.1: Mukesh Kumar delivers on a length to off, allowing Curtis Heaphy to get behind the line and block it straight down the track.
3.2: Mukesh Kumar finds a good length outside off where the ball nips away, and Curtis Heaphy watches it through to the keeper.
3.3: Mukesh Kumar attacks the fifth stump channel with a short of length delivery, leaving Curtis Heaphy to lift his bat skywards and let it go.
3.4: Mukesh Kumar produces a stellar delivery fuller on off that nips away at the last moment to beat Curtis Heaphy's tentative push.
3.5: Mukesh Kumar pitches fuller on a stump-to-stump line, allowing Curtis Heaphy to flick it smoothly toward mid-on.
3.6: Mukesh Kumar locates that venomous channel outside off, nibbling it past Curtis Heaphy's forward prod to seal a relentless maiden.
4.1: Mohammed Siraj tempts Rhys Mariu with an inviting full length, but the batter watches the away-swing sail harmlessly into the gloves.
4.2: Mohammed Siraj offers width from a back-of-a-length delivery, allowing Rhys Mariu to rise tall and pierce the cover point fence for his first boundary.
4.3: Mohammed Siraj hits a nagging length just outside off, prompting Rhys Mariu to tuck his bat and make a disciplined leave.
4.4: Mohammed Siraj drops a fuller delivery on an away-swinging trajectory, watching Rhys Mariu comfortably ignore it.
4.5: Mohammed Siraj strikes as Rhys Mariu pokes with leaden feet at an angled length delivery, feathering an edge through to Dhruv Jurel.
4.6: No run for Tim Robinson off Mohammed Siraj.
6.2: Mohammed Siraj attacks the full outside channel, and Tim Robinson carves the away-swinger straight into the cover-point fielder's hands.
6.3: Mohammed Siraj offers a good length just outside off, leaving Tim Robinson to loft his blade skywards and let it pass.
6.4: Mohammed Siraj digs it in short and angles down leg, forcing Tim Robinson into an across-the-line swipe that entirely misses the target.
6.5: Mohammed Siraj probes fuller outside off with late away-swing, leaving a searching Tim Robinson beaten all ends up on the outside edge.
6.6: Mohammed Siraj raps Tim Robinson high on the pads with a leg-stumper, sparking an optimistic appeal that trickles away for a leg bye.
7.1: Mukesh Kumar bangs it back of a length, allowing Tim Robinson to dab to backward point and scramble three chaotic runs off an overthrow.
7.2: Mukesh Kumar hits the corridor with a vicious delivery that straightens off the pitch, opening up Curtis Heaphy and leaving him grasping at air.
7.3: Mukesh Kumar delivers a length ball shaping in, but Curtis Heaphy marches down the track to block it firmly.
7.4: Mukesh Kumar lures Curtis Heaphy into a wide drive that catches the thick edge, flying straight to Yashasvi Jaiswal at gully.
7.5: Mukesh Kumar targets leg-stump from back of a length, deflecting off Matthew Boyle's pads toward square leg for a leg bye.
7.6: Mukesh Kumar strikes with a vicious nip-backer that catches Tim Robinson rooted on the crease, trapping him plumb in front to send the hosts reeling into lunch.
8.1: Siraj angles it sharply into the pads, leaving Matthew Boyle to dead-bat the delivery quietly toward the leg-side cordon.
8.2: Mohammed Siraj attacks the channel, angling it full and away as Matthew Boyle offers no shot, watching it die comfortably short of the glovework.
8.3: Mohammed Siraj finds the inswinger targeting middle and off, flicked crisply toward midwicket where Padikkal fumbles the collect, granting Boyle a single.

17.6: Washington Sundar fires it full and spinning down leg, leaving Dean Foxcroft grasping at air as Dhruv Jurel is completely blocked out by the batter's movement and watches helplessly as four byes race past him.
18.1: Akash Deep attacks with a skiddy length delivery that thuds into Matthew Boyle's front pad, triggering a hopeful appeal that is correctly dismissed for pitching outside leg.
18.2: Akash Deep digs it in on a short of length, allowing Matthew Boyle to work the ball cleanly in front of square on the on-side for a comfortable brace.
18.3: Akash Deep offers a tempting delivery outside off, and Matthew Boyle gets half-forward to punch it straight of mid-on with authoritative timing for four.
18.4: Akash Deep persists with a similar line, but Matthew Boyle miscuing his drive can only send the ball tamely straight to mid-on.
18.5: Akash Deep goes round the wicket on a wide length outside off, inviting Matthew Boyle to watch the ball sail harmlessly through to the keeper.
18.6: Akash Deep dishes out a full delivery, which Matthew Boyle meets firmly only to hit it straight to the extra cover fielder.
19.1: Washington Sundar darts one away, prompting Dean Foxcroft to play back and feather an outside edge wide of the slip fielder for a single.
19.2: Washington Sundar serves up a length delivery, and Matthew Boyle clears his front leg from the crease to punch it through the covers.
19.3: Washington Sundar extracts sharp turn from a length into the pads, beating Dean Foxcroft's defensive inside edge as the ball deflects away toward square leg.
19.4: Washington Sundar tosses it up fuller, allowing Dean Foxcroft to simply knock the ball down to long-on.
19.5: Washington Sundar floats a full delivery outside off, and Matthew Boyle drives it aerially through the cover region for a single.
19.6: Washington Sundar tosses it full, and Dean Foxcroft works it away through square leg for a single.
20.1: Akash Deep slides a skiddy length delivery past the channel outside off, allowing Dean Foxcroft to leave alone.
20.2: Akash Deep attacks with a fuller length, inducing Dean Foxcroft to shift across and tuck it firmly into the leg side.
20.3: Akash Deep extracts some subtle away movement outside off, safely watched past by Dean Foxcroft.
20.4: Akash Deep serves it up, and Dean Foxcroft drives straight past mid-off to hustle back for a comfortable brace.
20.5: Akash Deep pitches it full outside off, tempting Dean Foxcroft into a defensive push that beats the outside edge entirely.
20.6: Akash Deep finishes the over with a wide, low-staying length ball that Dean Foxcroft calmly ignores as drinks are called.
30.5: Mukesh Kumar targets the middle stump with a back-of-a-length delivery that straightens, squaring up Dean Foxcroft who manages to block it dead down the pitch.
30.6: Mukesh Kumar hits a hard length on off and gets it to seam away, prompting Foxcroft to camp back and push the ball toward the covers.
31.1: Mohammed Siraj pitches on a length across middle and off with late away swing, inviting Matthew Boyle to offer a watchful leave.
31.2: Mohammed Siraj digs it back of a length and shapes it away from middle and off, where Boyle hangs back to punch firmly toward mid-off.
31.3: Mohammed Siraj tests Boyle with a shortish delivery angling away, drawing a cross-line swipe that flies straight to the fielder at wide mid-on.
31.4: Mohammed Siraj drops short around the hips, allowing Boyle to shift inside the line and nudge it away toward fine leg for a single.
31.5: Mohammed Siraj floats a full one outside off with a hint of aerial movement, and Foxcroft leans forward to drive on the rise straight to wide mid-off.
31.6: Mohammed Siraj serves a sharp short-of-length delivery in the sixth-stump channel that nips inward, covered expertly by Foxcroft as he lets it go.
32.1: Mukesh Kumar tosses a fuller delivery outside off, and Boyle drives it crisply toward the cover fielder.
32.2: Mukesh Kumar attacks the channel with a back-of-a-length ball that nips away, safely pointed at by Boyle's raised bat as he leaves it alone.
32.3: Mukesh Kumar strays wide outside off on a length, yielding a crisp drive from Boyle straight to mid-off as the umpire signals a no-ball for another front-foot overstep.

32.3: Mukesh Kumar unleashes a searing inswinging yorker that Matthew Boyle barely manages to jam out from the inner half toward mid-wicket for a single, leaving the bowler clutching his head in sheer disbelief.
32.4: Mukesh Kumar pins a good length delivery in the channel, and Dean Foxcroft gets right behind it to dead-bat toward mid-on.
32.5: Mukesh Kumar offers a tempting width outside off that drifts away, but Dean Foxcroft resists the bait and lets it pass.
32.6: Mukesh Kumar drifts one into the pads, allowing Dean Foxcroft to tickle it toward mid-wicket where a fumble gifts the single that brings up the hundred for New Zealand A.
33.1: Mohammed Siraj hits a nagging short of a length on off that bites away, inviting Dean Foxcroft to watch it sail through to the keeper.
33.2: Mohammed Siraj angles a full delivery into middle and leg, prompting a forward prod straight back before the bowler delivers a lingering glare.
33.3: Mohammed Siraj targets a back-of-a-length spot outside off with sharp inward movement, which Dean Foxcroft negotiates securely by shuffling across.
38.6: Mukesh Kumar targets the channel, and Dean Foxcroft meets it firmly with a defensive push into the off-side.
39.1: Manav Suthar floats it up invitingly, and Matthew Boyle simply returns it down the pitch.
39.2: Matthew Boyle tucks Suthar fine to reach his fifty, acknowledging the milestone amidst warm applause.
